notes.title: Added multiple new features.
notes.content:
[h3][b]Added the following:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Collectable Journal entries from the terminal to the Glove Menu.
[*] Checkpoint system triggered by objective updates or collecting key cards.
[*] Modular mission objective system for easier level creation.
[*] More dialog triggers.
[*] Signal receivers now turn off after activation.
[*] A way to turn off the UI in the camera mode to assist with recording footage.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs related to audio cutting off after re-spawning.
[*] Fixed bugs with the new loading system.
[*] Fixed bugs with the player rag-doll.
[/list]
